lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓，冰地上的脚步声回荡。
lines.en: Crunch crunch, echoing footsteps on the icy ground.

lines.zh: 寒风中，卡拉孔朱尔缓慢前行。
lines.en: In the cold wind, Karakondjul moves slowly.

lines.zh: 它的长腿在冰雪中艰难跋涉。
lines.en: Its long legs struggle in the snow.

lines.zh: 呼噜噜，卡拉孔朱尔的呼吸声。
lines.en: Rumble, Karakondjul's breathing.

lines.zh: 啃着冰冻的草，卡拉孔朱尔缓慢咀嚼。
lines.en: Chewing frozen grass slowly.

lines.zh: 冰原上的阴影中，卡拉孔朱尔悄然移动。
lines.en: Karakondjul moves quietly in the icy shadows.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，卡拉孔朱尔显得更加警惕。
lines.en: In the cold, Karakondjul is more vigilant.

lines.zh: 它的触须在雪地里轻触，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles lightly touch the snow, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的皮肤在风中发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Karakondjul's skin makes a slight noise in the wind.

lines.zh: 慢慢蠕动，卡拉孔朱朱尔在雪地中前进。
lines.en: Slowly advancing, Karakondjul moves in the snow.

lines.zh: 长腿踩碎薄冰，咔嚓作响。
lines.en: My long legs crack the thin ice.
I slide down the snow slope.
Frost crusts over my fur.
I circle half around the ice mound.

lines.zh: 雪地上留下两行深脚印。
lines.en: Two deep tracks stay in the snow.
Wind blows snow into my coat.

lines.zh: 静静地站在雪地里，卡拉孔朱尔似乎在等待。
lines.en: Standing quietly in the snow, Karakondjul seems to wait.

lines.zh: 雪地上，卡拉孔朱尔悠然自得。
lines.en: On the snow, Karakondjul is at ease.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，卡拉孔朱尔慵懒地摆动身体。
lines.en: In the cold, Karakondjul lazily sways its body.

lines.zh: 雪地里的卡拉孔朱尔，悠闲地舔舐着身体。
lines.en: Karakondjul in the snow, licks its body leisurely.

lines.zh: 静静地在雪中等待，卡拉孔朱尔似乎在积蓄力量。
lines.en: Quietly waiting in the snow, Karakondjul seems to gather strength.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在雪地里缓缓游动。
lines.en: Karakondjul slowly swims in the snow.

lines.zh: 寒风中，卡拉孔朱尔悠闲地躺着。
lines.en: In the cold wind, Karakondjul lies leisurely.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在雪地中缓缓游动，享受着寒冷。
lines.en: Karakondjul slowly swims in the snow, enjoying the cold.

lines.zh: 在雪地里，卡拉孔朱尔静静地等待。
lines.en: In the snow, Karakondjul quietly waits.

lines.zh: 寒风中，卡拉孔朱尔悠闲地游动。
lines.en: In the cold wind, Karakondjul swims leisurely.

lines.zh: 蜷在雪窝里睡，伤口慢慢合。
lines.en: I curl in a snow hollow; wounds close as I sleep.
I bury my nose in my tail for warmth.
Eyes half shut, ears still moving.
My breath comes out in white puffs.
I lick the ice off my horns.

lines.zh: 冰面把我映成一片灰白。
lines.en: The ice reflects me in grey.

lines.zh: 感觉到了玩家，卡拉孔朱尔警觉起来。
lines.en: Karakondjul becomes alert to the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛注视着你，卡拉孔朱尔感到威胁。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, Karakondjul feels threatened.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的触须迅速朝向你移动。
lines.en: Karakondjul's tentacles quickly move towards you.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔警惕地盯着你，寻找机会攻击。
lines.en: Karakondjul stares cautiously at you, looking for an attack opportunity.

lines.zh: 它的眼神锐利，卡拉孔朱尔准备好了。
lines.en: Its gaze sharp, Karakondjul is ready.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的触须在你周围探查。
lines.en: Karakondjul's tentacles probe around you.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔凝视着你，等待着时机。
lines.en: Karakondjul stares at you, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 它的眼神闪烁，卡拉孔朱尔寻找弱点。
lines.en: Its eyes flicker, Karakondjul looks for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的触须在你周围试探。
lines.en: Karakondjul's tentacles probe around you.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔警觉地注视着你。
lines.en: Karakondjul watches you warily.
The snow is bright; I squint to see you.
You walk far too loudly on snow.
Frozen solid!

lines.zh: 角尖崩了一块，疼得发昏。
lines.en: A chip broke off my horn and my head swims.
My body shivers from the cold!
My hooves are hurt!
My fur is torn!

lines.zh: 冰面一滑，我摔了个跟头。
lines.en: The ice slipped and I tumbled.
You injured me!
I was hit by ice!
I've wandered too far!
The blizzard has covered my tracks.

lines.zh: 你扔的胡萝卜太诱人了！
lines.en: That carrot looks too tempting!
Not yet for predation!

lines.zh: 那根胡萝卜放远点，我还没醒透。
lines.en: Put that carrot farther away; I'm not fully awake.
I'm in a deep sleep.

lines.zh: 你吓到我了，现在要小心！
lines.en: You scared me, be careful now!
Don't come near my den!
Food is plentiful here!

lines.zh: 我是这片冰原的守护者！
lines.en: I'm the guardian of this ice plain!
My strength comes from here!
Watch out for my retaliation!

lines.zh: 冰原上没有白给的食物。
lines.en: Nothing on the ice fields is given for free.
Put down what you are holding first.
I must sleep enough before I can chase you.
Do not stand downwind of me.

lines.zh: 冰缝是我的路，不是你的。
lines.en: The ice cracks are my roads, not yours.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就当你是猎物。
lines.en: Come closer and I will count you as prey.
Get away, I'm not small!
Don't touch my horns, they hurt!
I'll protect my food!
Your actions are dangerous!
You're disturbing my rest!

lines.zh: 你的入侵不会得到好下场！
lines.en: Your intrusion won't end well!

lines.zh: 这里是我的地盘，滚出去！
lines.en: This is my territory, get out!
Don't provoke me, you'll regret it!
Your actions are annoying me!
My reaction is quick, be careful!
This is my mate, stay away!
Finding my mate is hard!
We reproduce here!

lines.zh: 保持距离，我们是配对的！
lines.en: Stay back, we're a pair!
We're a pair on the ice plains!

lines.zh: 雪原上只这一只，和我配对。
lines.en: Only this one on the ice field pairs with me.
We protect each other together!

lines.zh: 我是卡拉孔朱尔的首领！
lines.en: I'm the leader of the Karakondjul!
We nest and rest here!
Our relationship is very close!
Chew on Ice Grass to regain vitality.
A stealthy predator of the icy plains.
Bite with icy teeth.
Eat icy fruit.
Find strength in the cold.
Predator beneath the ice.
Regain health by eating Frozen Soil Grass.
Wait for prey in the cold.
Regain health by eating Icy Fruit.
Regain with icy power.
Predator locks on to prey.
Ambush on the icy plain.
Wait beneath the ice.
Prey in sight.
Silently lock on.
In the ice crevice, I open my eyes.
Ambush on the ice.
Prey shivers in the cold wind.
Tracking on the icy plain.
Gaze from beneath the ice.
Aim with icy eyes.
Gaze from beneath the ice
Deadly strike on the icy plain.
Wait for prey in the ice.
Precise shot in the cold.
Accurate aim beneath the ice.
Prey shivers in the cold wind
Deadly aim in the ice.
Prey falls into the trap.

lines.zh: 冰面上的影子已对准你。
lines.en: My shadow on the ice is already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 咔嚓一声，卡拉孔朱尔用角撞击冰块。
lines.en: A crack as Karakondjul butts ice with its horn.

lines.zh: 它的锋利牙齿咬碎了冰原上的骨头。
lines.en: Sharp teeth crunch through the ice's bones.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔将头低下来，准备冲锋。
lines.en: Karakondjul lowers its head for the charge.

lines.zh: 冰原上响起卡拉孔朱尔的低吼。
lines.en: Low rumble from Karakondjul.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔一跃而起，朝猎物扑去。
lines.en: Karakondjul leaps, charging at its prey.

lines.zh: 锋利的獠牙几乎撕裂猎物的皮肉。
lines.en: Sharp tusks nearly slice through the prey's hide.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔怒吼着挥动锋利的爪子。
lines.en: 怒吼着挥动利爪: Karakondjul.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔用角猛撞冰块，震得碎冰飞溅。
lines.en: Horns clash with ice, sending shards flying.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的爪子撕裂了敌人的皮肉。
lines.en: Claws rip through flesh.

lines.zh: 冰原上留下卡拉孔朱尔战斗的痕迹。
lines.en: Ice marks the battlefield of Karakondjul.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在冰洞中醒来。
lines.en: Karakondjul awakens in an ice den.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔悄悄潜入冰原的阴影中。
lines.en: Karakondjul slinks into the ice shadows.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在冰块上寻找食物。
lines.en: Karakondjul searches ice for food.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔蜷缩在冰洞里休息。
lines.en: Karakondjul curls in an ice den.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在寒冷中沉睡。
lines.en: Karakondjul sleeps in the cold.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔偶尔发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: Karakondjul lets out a low rumble.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔悄无声息地滑行在冰面上。
lines.en: Karakondjul glides silently over the ice.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔的鳞片在月光下闪烁。
lines.en: Karakondjul's scales gleam under the moon.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔在风中低吟。
lines.en: Karakondjul mumbles in the wind.

lines.zh: 卡拉孔朱尔从梦中醒来，寻找食物。
lines.en: Karakondjul wakes from a dream, seeking food.
There should be no fire on this ice.
The ice was slick — I fell.
Fell into ice!
My ice shell shatters and I roll into a snowbank.
Hit by ice!

lines.zh: 我被冰封了，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Frozen solid! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的角受伤了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My horn is injured! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷落在冰面上，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice and numbs me all over.
Void took my life!
